mapper.select: SELECT vc.id, vc.video_id AS videoId, vc.user_id AS userId, vc.parent_id AS parentId, vc.content, vc.created_at AS createdAt, u.username, u.nickname, COALESCE(reply_count.replyCount, 0) AS replyCount FROM video_comment vc INNER JOIN sys_user u ON vc.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT parent_id, COUNT(1) AS replyCount FROM video_comment WHERE status = 1 AND video_id = #{videoId} AND parent_id <> 0 GROUP BY parent_id ) reply_count ON reply_count.parent_id = vc.id WHERE vc.video_id = #{videoId} AND vc.parent_id = 0 AND vc.status = 1 ORDER BY vc.created_at DESC, vc.id DESC

SELECT vc.id, vc.video_id AS videoId, vc.user_id AS userId, vc.parent_id AS parentId, vc.content, vc.created_at AS createdAt, u.username, u.nickname FROM video_comment vc INNER JOIN sys_user u ON vc.user_id = u.id WHERE vc.video_id = #{videoId} AND vc.parent_id = #{parentId} AND vc.status = 1 ORDER BY vc.created_at ASC, vc.id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE video_comment SET status = 0, deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{commentId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
UPDATE video_comment SET status = 0, deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{commentId} AND status = 1
UPDATE video_comment SET status = 0, deleted_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND status = 1
UPDATE video_comment SET status = 1, deleted_at = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{commentId} AND status = 0
